create_ManualChangesPerception: create a ManualChangesPerception instance with an agent and perception frequency for tracking dashboard edits
perceive_dashboard_edits: call perceive on ManualChangesPerception to return CraftAssistPerceptionData with current dashboard edits and groups
process_change_edit: process a change dict with type edit, restore, or group to update ManualChangesPerception state
add_edit_to_perception: add a flattened edit dict to ManualChangesPerception storing changed attributes by memid key
make_group_of_objects: make a named group of objects in ManualChangesPerception by passing group name and selected objects dict
